name: scope-access
title: Scope Access
description: One access core for every membership scope (app, org, or an entity type such as data_room): members, invitations, profiles, capabilities, pending invitations, workspaces and files, named from the scope by the backend's conventions.
docs: `scope-access` installed the framework-free core under `src/blocks/scope-access`. Hosts with Console Kit get it through `console-module-users`; hosts without Console Kit add `scope-panels` and wrap the app in `ScopeAccessProvider` with their endpoints, signed-in user id and token getter. Read the active workspace outside React with `activeWorkspaceId('org')` from `@/blocks/scope-access/workspace-store`.
